notes.title: Update of 09/09/2025
notes.content:
✅ Maintenance is complete!


A brand-new update is now available 🎉


✨ New Content:


New temporary missions are now active

Added several missing items and buildings

Introduced a new way to consume items directly from your inventory more easily



🔧 Improvements:

Various bug fixes to make the server more stable and responsive



Enjoy the game! 🌴

notes.title: 🧑‍🌾 Recruitment is now available!
notes.content:
🧑‍🌾Recrutement disponible !


The administrative buildings recruitment system is now fully functional and officially part of the supported features!



🔃Currently rolling out — it may take a few hours before it's available to everyone.



⚠️ The automatic recruitment has therefore been disabled.

notes.title: Energy Update !
notes.content:
The energy update is available!

📢 Update Highlights


⚡ Daily Bonus Boost

    •    Win reward increased: 5 → 15 Energy



🧪 Max Energy Potion

    •    Price drop: 250 Gems → 50 Gems (+7 Max Energy)



🌾 Barley Harvest Buff

    •    Barley: Drop rate 10% → 50%, now yields 3 Malt per drop instead of 1 malt

    •    Super Barley: Drop rate 50% → 100%



🏭 Distillery Upgrade

    •    Old: -1 Malt + 5 min = 1 Energy

    •    New: -50 Malt + 100 min = 50 Energy 



🌱 Crop Energy Increase

    •    Energy drop chance: 10% → 20%



👥 Friends List Expansion

    •    Max friends: 150→ 200



🛒 New: Vending Machine (Thanks to Byakkoya to highlight this)

    •    Cost: 150 Gold Coins

    •    Drops: 3 Energy Lunch (+3 Energy each) every 120 min

    •    Bonus Drops:

    •    🍯 Osiris Nectar: 0.1%

    •    ⚱️ Energy Chalice: 1%

    •    🍖 Dinner of Pharaoh: 4%

    •    🥘 Energy Feast: 5%

notes.title: Update – August 6th, 2025
notes.content:
📅 Patch Note – August 6th, 2025



Hello everyone,

A maintenance was performed today to bring several improvements and fixes.



Here’s a summary of the changes:

🔍 New Content
  Police Missions are now available until the end of September.

🧩 User Experience Improvements
  The order of your missions is now saved after restarting the game.

🌍 Localization
  Several translation errors in the interface and dialogues have been corrected.

🧙‍♀️ Pyramid & Random Items
  Fixed random rewards related to the Pyramid and other events.
  → No more Witch Collections invading your valleys by mistake!

  🔧 The XP value of some shop items has been adjusted.


🖥️ Display
  Resolution adjustments for better compatibility with 2560px+ screens.
  Various minor bugs have also been fixed.

 💖 Several bugs have been fixed. 


Thank you for your continued support, and see you soon in your valleys! 💛

notes.title: Update: 60 FPS & Faster Animations!
notes.content:
We have deployed an update to improve your gameplay experience.



⚡ FPS increased: 30➡️ 60 for smoother gameplay

🗺️ Faster map transitions

🛒 Sliding speed improved – shop & inventory now quicker

🏃‍♂️ Character speed boosted by +25%

🎁 Jackpot & Daily Bonus animations are faster

👥 Faster friend map visits



Jump in and feel the difference! 💥

notes.title: Update – July 24, 2025
notes.content:
An update was deployed this morning.


Here are the changes made during the maintenance:

🏛️ Recruitment cost in administrative buildings has been reduced to 1 gem

⏱️ Automatic recruitment delay lowered to 24h (instead of 48h)

⚡ Powers of the Gods are now usable on all maps
→ A bug that occasionally prevents them from triggering is under investigation

✅ Performance improvements when accepting a gift or switching maps

We are actively working on fixing more bugs in upcoming updates.
Thank you for your continued support ❤️
